name: Yugi Muto
title: King of Games
tagline: Heart of the Cards & Master Tactician
description: A kind-hearted high school student who solved the ancient Millennium Puzzle. Yugi trusts completely in the Heart of the Cards and uses clever defensive and toolbox combos.

decks.name: Silent & Gadget Arsenal
decks.description: Yugi Muto's ceremonial masterpiece deck featuring the mechanical Gadget trio, the evolving Silent LV warriors, and the apocalyptic Gandora the Dragon of Destruction.

decks.name: Magna Warrior & Silent Magician
decks.description: Yugi's electromagnetic rock deck uniting Alpha, Beta, and Gamma to summon the mighty Valkyrion the Magna Warrior alongside Silent Magician.

decks.name: Magician Girls & Gadget Dimension
decks.description: Yugi Muto's canonical Dark Side of Dimensions deck linking the six Magician Girls with Gold and Silver Gadget recursion and defensive dimension barriers.

name: Yami Yugi
title: Pharaoh of the Millennium
tagline: Master of Dark Magic & The Egyptian Gods
description: The ancient Egyptian Pharaoh Atem. He commands the Ultimate Wizard Dark Magician, the Egyptian God Slifer the Sky Dragon, and legendary rituals.

decks.name: Duelist Kingdom Exodia & Chaos
decks.description: The Pharaoh's legendary Duelist Kingdom deck featuring the unstoppable Exodia the Forbidden One, Black Luster Soldier, Gaia the Dragon Champion, and Summoned Skull.

decks.name: Battle City Slifer & Dark Magician
decks.description: Atem's Battle City championship deck centered on the Ultimate Wizard Dark Magician, Dark Magician Girl, Buster Blader, and the divine Egyptian God Slifer the Sky Dragon.

decks.name: Legendary Dragon of Timaeus
decks.description: The ancient bonds of Atem awakened through The Eye of Timaeus, merging Dark Magician and Dark Magician Girl into draconic knights against the darkness.

decks.name: Ceremonial Battle: Three Egyptian Gods
decks.description: Atem's transcendent final deck summoning all three Egyptian Gods simultaneously through the Royal Court Face Knights and Arcana Knight Joker.

name: Seto Kaiba
title: CEO of KaibaCorp
description: The president of KaibaCorp and master of Blue-Eyes White Dragon. Kaiba believes in overwhelming strength, crushing virus traps, and futuristic machine unions.

decks.name: Duelist Kingdom Blue-Eyes Ultimate
decks.description: Kaiba's ruthless Duelist Kingdom power deck featuring three legendary Blue-Eyes White Dragons and their catastrophic fusion, Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

decks.name: Battle City Obelisk & XYZ Cannon
decks.description: Kaiba's Battle City high-tech arsenal, combining the supreme divine wrath of Obelisk the Tormentor with XYZ-Dragon Cannon and Blue-Eyes White Dragon.

decks.name: Neo Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Ritual
decks.description: Kaiba's supreme modern transcendence deck summoning the invincible Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon with Chaos Form and fusing Neo Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.

decks.name: Crush Card & Virus Lockdown
decks.description: Kaiba's classic video-game control deck decimating the opponent's hand and field with Crush Card Virus and Deck Devastation Virus while commanding high-ATK beaters.

name: Joey Wheeler
title: The Underdog Duelist
description: A street-smart duelist with unyielding courage. Joey wins through daring gambles, coin-flip turnarounds, and his legendary Red-Eyes Black Dragon.

decks.name: Duelist Kingdom Gamble & Dragons
decks.description: Joey Wheeler's passionate underdog deck from Duelist Kingdom, starring Red-Eyes Black Dragon, Time Wizard, Flame Swordsman, and Thousand Dragon.

decks.name: Battle City Warrior & Jinzo
decks.description: Joey Wheeler's Battle City championship deck featuring the trap-annihilating Jinzo, Gearfried the Iron Knight, Rocket Warrior, and Red-Eyes Black Dragon.

decks.name: The Claw of Hermos & Lord of the Red
decks.description: Joey's Waking the Dragons armory wielding The Claw of Hermos to forge dragon weapons alongside the explosive ritual armor of Lord of the Red.

name: Téa Gardner
title: Heartwarming Spirit
description: The moral compass of the gang. Téa heals life points and commands radiant Fairies and Magician Girls with cheerful determination.

decks.name: Angelic Friendship & St. Joan
decks.description: Téa Gardner's compassionate fairy deck from Nightmare Troubadour, Tag Force, and the Virtual World, utilizing continuous Life Point regeneration and St. Joan.

name: Tristan Taylor
title: Tough-Guy Guardian
description: Yugi's loyal protector who fights with gritty machine soldiers, heavy battle armor, and Cyber Commander tactics.

decks.name: Battleguard & Cyber Assault
decks.description: Tristan Taylor's hard-hitting brawler deck from Duel Links, featuring Roboyarou, Robolady, Super Roboyarou, and the mighty Battleguard brothers.

name: Mai Valentine
title: Harpy Queen of the Wind
description: A stylish and glamorous duelist who commands the Harpie Lady flock, Hunting Grounds, and fierce Amazoness warriors.

decks.name: Duelist Kingdom Harpie Swarm
decks.description: Mai Valentine's classic fragrance tactic deck multiplying Harpie Ladies with Elegant Egotist and buffing Harpie's Pet Dragon.

decks.name: Battle City Amazoness & Harpies
decks.description: Mai's aggressive Battle City tournament deck merging ferocious Amazoness combatants with the tactical strikes of Harpie Ladies.

decks.name: Seal of Orichalcos Harpie Flight
decks.description: Mai's corrupted Doma deck boosting her Harpie flock with The Seal of Orichalcos and executing sweeping aerial assaults with Harpie Lady Phoenix Formation.

name: Bakura Ryou
title: Tomb Robber of the Millennium Ring
description: Host to the evil spirit of the Millennium Ring. Bakura plays deadly occult decks, Destiny Board word-spells, and graveyard-haunting fiends.

decks.name: Battle City Destiny Board
decks.description: Yami Bakura's chilling occult deck spelling the inevitable F-I-N-A-L doom through Destiny Board and the horrifying Dark Necrofear.

decks.name: Dark Master - Zorc & Occult Fiends
decks.description: Bakura's dark video-game ritual deck rolling the die of doom with Dark Master - Zorc while disrupting opposing boards with Doomcaliber Knight and occult fiends.

name: Marik Ishtar
title: Tomb Keeper of the Sun God
tagline: The Winged Dragon of Ra & Shadow Torture
description: Leader of the Rare Hunters and wielder of the Millennium Rod. Marik inflicts agonizing burn damage and commands The Winged Dragon of Ra.

decks.name: Immortal Winged Dragon of Ra
decks.description: Yami Marik's sadistic torture deck unleashing Lava Golem, Nightmare Wheel, and the ultimate divine beast, The Winged Dragon of Ra.

decks.name: Slime Control & Torture Lockdown
decks.description: Marik's agonizing Battle City control deck locking down the field with Revival Jam, Jam Defender, and Metal Reflect Slime while inflicting torture burn with Lava Golem.

name: Maximillion Pegasus
title: Creator of Duel Monsters
description: The eccentric creator of Duel Monsters and holder of the Millennium Eye. Pegasus bypasses defense with cartoonish Toons and absorbs souls with Relinquished.

decks.name: Toon World Kingdom
decks.description: The creator of Duel Monsters reveals his whimsical and invincible cartoon creations popping straight out of Toon World.

decks.name: Relinquished & Thousand-Eyes Restrict
decks.description: Pegasus's horrifying dark illusion deck absorbing opposing monsters as equip spells with Relinquished and Thousand-Eyes Restrict.

name: Bandit Keith
title: US National Champion
description: Former US Champion duelist known for his ruthless machine monsters, coin-toss artillery like Blowback and Gatling Dragon, and sneaky traps.

decks.name: Duelist Kingdom Heavy Machines
decks.description: Bandit Keith's American Machine arsenal gunning down enemies with Blowback Dragon, Twin-Barrel Dragon, Machine King, and heavy Metalmorph upgrades.

name: Weevil Underwood
title: Regional Insect Champion
description: The calculating Japanese Regional Champion. Weevil traps opponents behind Insect Barrier and evolves Petit Moth into Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth.

decks.name: Perfect Great Moth Evolution
decks.description: Weevil Underwood's signature forest deck defending the Cocoon of Evolution until the cataclysmic Perfectly Ultimate Great Moth emerges.

decks.name: Battle City Insect Queen Swarm
decks.description: Weevil's Battle City swarm deck infesting the opponent's cards with Parasite Paracide and feeding the mighty Insect Queen.

name: Rex Raptor
title: Dinosaur Tyrant
description: Regional runner-up and dinosaur fanatic. Rex stomps rivals with prehistoric titans like Ultimate Tyranno, Black Tyranno, and Red-Eyes.

decks.name: Duelist Kingdom Dinosaur Rampage
decks.description: Rex Raptor's Jurassic beatdown deck from Duelist Kingdom, starring Two-Headed King Rex, Uraby, Crawling Dragon #2, and Serpent Night Dragon.

decks.name: Seal of Orichalcos Tyrant Dinosaur
decks.description: Rex Raptor's Doma deck combining prehistoric carnivores and high-level dragons under The Seal of Orichalcos with Tyrant Dragon and Black Tyranno.

name: Mako Tsunami
title: Ocean Master of the Seas
tagline: Sea Stealth Umi & The Legendary Fisherman
description: A sea-faring fisherman duelist who hides his monsters beneath Umi waves and protects the honor of his father with The Legendary Fisherman.

decks.name: Ocean Realm & Legendary Fisherman
decks.description: Mako Tsunami's oceanic powerhouse deck hiding beneath the tidal waves of A Legendary Ocean and striking with The Legendary Fisherman and Amphibian Beast.

decks.name: Ocean Lord Levia-Dragon Daedalus
decks.description: Mako's devastating video-game boss deck sacrificing A Legendary Ocean to wipe the entire opponent's field with Levia-Dragon - Daedalus and Neo-Daedalus.

name: Ishizu Ishtar
title: Guardian of the Millennium Necklace
tagline: Exchange of the Spirit & Gravekeeper Prophecy
description: Keeper of the Egyptian Antiquities and the Millennium Necklace. Ishizu sees the future, commands Gravekeepers, and flips graveyards with Exchange of the Spirit.

decks.name: Gravekeeper's & Exchange of the Spirit
decks.description: Ishizu Ishtar's Millennium Necklace prophetic deck manipulating graveyard states and reversing destinies with Exchange of the Spirit.

name: Odion
title: Loyal Guardian of the Ishtar Tomb
tagline: Embodiment of Apophis & Mystical Beast Serket
description: Marik's sworn protector. Odion overwhelms opponents with continuous Trap Monsters like Apophis and the devastating Mystical Beast of Serket.

decks.name: Temple of the Kings & Apophis
decks.description: Odion's stoic trap fortress deck punishing attackers through Embodiment of Apophis and releasing the forbidden Mystical Beast of Serket.

name: Espa Roba
title: Psychic Duelist & Jinzo Master
description: The psychic duelist with extraordinary tactical mind-reading. Espa Roba shuts down all opponent Traps with Jinzo and Jinzo - Lord.

decks.name: Jinzo Psychic Shockwave
decks.description: Espa Roba's psychic transmission deck nullifying all traps on the field with Jinzo, Jinzo - Returner, and Jinzo - Lord.

name: Arkana
title: Master of Dark Magic Illusion
description: The illusionist magician and Rare Hunter. Arkana wields the red-robed Dark Magician, sinister Ectoplasmer tributes, and sawblade traps.

decks.name: Show of Illusion & Red Dark Magician
decks.description: Arkana's deadly Pandora magic show sacrificing monsters to Ectoplasmer and commanding his ruthless red-robed Dark Magician.

name: Rafael
title: Noble Doma Guardian
description: The virtuous member of Doma. Rafael treats his Guardian monsters as comrades, never letting them fall to the Graveyard, and summons Guardian Eatos.

decks.name: Guardians of Sacred Light
decks.description: Rafael's deep bond with his monsters refusing to send them to the graveyard, commanding Guardian Eatos and ancestral guardian weapons.

decks.name: Dark Rafael: Guardian Dreadscythe
decks.description: Rafael giving in to the darkness: unleashing Guardian Dreadscythe and Reaper Scythe - Dreadscythe to drain the strength of fallen souls in both graveyards.

name: Dartz
title: King of Atlantis
tagline: The Seal of Orichalcos & Great Leviathan
description: The ancient King of Atlantis and leader of Doma. Dartz harnesses the 10,000-year-old Seal of Orichalcos and awakens the Great Leviathan.

decks.name: Orichalcos Seal of Atlantis
decks.description: Dartz's 10,000-year-old Atlantean empire deck channeling the malevolent power of The Seal of Orichalcos and Orichalcos Shunoros.

name: Jaden Yuki
title: Slifer Red Supreme Duelist
description: A fun-loving student at Duel Academy with unmatched instinct. Jaden fuses Elemental HEROs and contacts Neo-Spacians into cosmic warriors.

decks.name: Classic Elemental HERO
decks.description: Jaden Yuki's iconic early Duel Academy deck uniting Avian, Burstinatrix, Clayman, and Sparkman to summon Flame Wingman and Shining Flare Wingman.

decks.name: Neo-Spacian Contact Fusion
decks.description: Jaden's cosmic deck summoning Elemental HERO Neos and executing contact fusions with the six Neo-Spacians without Polymerization.

decks.name: Rainbow Neos & Supreme HERO
decks.description: Jaden's Season 4 pinnacle deck uniting Elemental HERO Neos and Jesse's Rainbow Dragon with Super Polymerization and Miracle Contact.

decks.name: Masked HERO Transformation
decks.description: Jaden's official GX manga deck utilizing Mask Change and Form Change to transform Elemental HEROs into Masked HERO Dark Law, Koga, and Dian.

name: Zane Truesdale
title: Kaiser of the Academy
tagline: Cyber Dragon Power Bond & Cyberdark Underworld
description: The undefeated top duelist of Duel Academy who later embraced the ruthless Hell Kaiser underworld style. Commands Cyber Dragon, Power Bond, and Cyberdarks.

decks.name: Cyber Dragon Power Bond
decks.description: The Kaiser's flawless academy deck combining Cyber Dragons with Power Bond to summon the 8000 ATK Cyber End Dragon.

decks.name: Hell Kaiser Cyberdark Underworld
decks.description: Zane's ruthless underworld deck equipping high-level dragons to Cyberdark Horn, Edge, and Keel to forge the devastating Cyberdark Dragon.

name: Syrus Truesdale
title: Vehicroid Engineer
description: Zane's determined younger brother. Syrus engineers cute and powerful Vehicroid machines, combining them with Vehicroid Connection Zone.

decks.name: Vehicroid Assembly Connection
decks.description: Syrus Truesdale's brave machine deck uniting Ambulanceroid, Rescueroid, Gyroid, and Drillroid to construct Super Vehicroid Jumbo Drill.

name: Chazz Princeton
title: Chazz It Up! (The Manjoume)
description: The arrogant and resilient prodigy of Duel Academy. Chazz commands the comical Ojama trio, evolving Armed Dragons, and VWXYZ catapult machines.

decks.name: Armed Dragon & Ojama Trio
decks.description: Chazz Princeton's legendary deck combining the explosive destruction of Ojama Delta Hurricane!! with the level-evolving power of Armed Dragon LV10.

decks.name: VWXYZ Catapult Cannon Union
decks.description: Chazz's elite North Academy machine union deck combining V-Tiger Jet, W-Wing Catapult, and XYZ-Dragon Cannon into VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon.

decks.name: Light and Darkness Dragon Dominion
decks.description: Chazz's legendary GX manga deck commanding Light and Darkness Dragon alongside Dragonic Knight and White-Horned Dragon to negate all opponent activations.

name: Alexis Rhodes
title: Queen of Obelisk Blue
description: The top female duelist at Duel Academy. Alexis performs graceful ice ballet with Cyber Blader and unleashes the divine Cyber Angel ritual goddesses.

decks.name: Cyber Angel Ritual Grace
decks.description: The Queen of Obelisk Blue's pure ritual deck commanding Cyber Angel Benten, Idaten, and the supreme ritual executor Cyber Angel Dakini.

decks.name: Cyber Girl Ballet Fusion
decks.description: Alexis's athletic combat deck fusing Blade Skater and Etoile Cyber into Cyber Blader to lock down opposing monsters, spells, and traps.

decks.name: Blizzard Princess & White Night
decks.description: Alexis's elegant GX manga deck freezing opposing spells and traps with Blizzard Princess and commanding the majestic White Night Dragon.

name: Bastion Misawa
title: The Formula Tactician
tagline: Water Dragon Chemistry & Six Attribute Decks
description: The analytical genius of Ra Yellow who created six distinct decks to counter every attribute. Commands Hydrogeddon, Bonding H2O, and Water Dragon.

decks.name: Chemical Bonding & Water Dragon
decks.description: Bastion Misawa's scientific deck combining 2 Hydrogeddon and 1 Oxygeddon via Bonding - H2O to summon the fire-quenching Water Dragon.

decks.name: Yokai Zombie Spirit Realm
decks.description: Bastion's legendary GX manga deck commanding Japanese Yokai spirits Gozuki, Mezuki, and Shutendoji to manipulate the graveyard and summon Revived King Ha Des.

name: Chumley Huffington
title: Beast Master of the Australian Outback
tagline: Master of Oz & Ayers Rock Sunrise
description: The laid-back Australian student and passionate card designer. Chumley commands massive Outback beasts, Des Koalas, and the 4200 ATK Master of Oz.

decks.name: Australian Beasts & Master of Oz
decks.description: Chumley's Australian wildlife deck fusing Big Koala and Des Kangaroo into the 4200 ATK behemoth Master of Oz with Ayers Rock Sunrise.

name: Aster Phoenix
title: Pro League Destiny Duelist
tagline: Destiny HERO Plasma & Clock Tower Prison
description: The top-ranked professional duelist. Aster commands dark Destiny HEROs, the Clock Tower of fate, and the monster-stealing Destiny HERO - Plasma.

decks.name: Destiny HERO Clock Tower
decks.description: Aster Phoenix's professional league deck counting down Clock Tower Prison to summon Dreadmaster, Dogma, and the supreme Destiny HERO - Plasma.

decks.name: Destiny End Dragoon Turbo
decks.description: Aster's supreme anime evolution fusing his ultimate destiny creations Plasma and Dogma into Destiny End Dragoon to incinerate enemy monsters with effect burn.

name: Jesse Anderson
title: Champion of the Crystal Beasts
description: The transfer student from North Academy who communicates with Duel Spirits. Jesse gathers all seven Crystal Beasts to summon Rainbow Dragon.

decks.name: Crystal Beast Rainbow Dragon
decks.description: Jesse Anderson's beloved deck gathering all 7 Crystal Beasts in the Spell & Trap Zone to awaken the incandescent Rainbow Dragon.

decks.name: Yubel-Possessed Advanced Crystal Beasts
decks.description: Jesse under Yubel's dark corruption transforming his Crystal Beasts with Advanced Dark to summon the 4000 ATK dark beast Rainbow Dark Dragon.

name: Dr. Vellian Crowler
title: Head Professor of Duel Academy
description: The eccentric Department Chair of Obelisk Blue. Crowler overwhelms students with Ancient Gear Golems that prevent spells and traps during battle.

decks.name: Ancient Gear Mechanical Dominion
decks.description: Duel Academy's Department Head unleashing un-negatable attacks with Ancient Gear Golem and fusing into Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem.

decks.name: Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem Fusion
decks.description: Crowler's ultimate mechanical lesson fusing three Ancient Gear titans with Power Bond into the 4400 ATK unstoppable Ultimate Ancient Gear Golem.

name: Atticus Rhodes
title: The Charismatic Red-Eyes Idol
description: Alexis's flashy older brother and top Obelisk Blue duelist. Atticus commands Red-Eyes Darkness Dragon, Dragon's Roar, and soaring draconic firepower.

decks.name: Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Inferno
decks.description: Atticus Rhodes's blazing dragon deck unleashing Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon and burning the opponent with Inferno Fire Blast.

name: Tyranno Hassleberry
title: The Dino-DNA Sergeant
description: The energetic sergeant of Ra Yellow with a dinosaur bone in his leg. Hassleberry leads his prehistoric squad with Ultimate Tyranno and Babycerasaurus.

decks.name: Ultimate Dinosaur Rampage
decks.description: Hassleberry's prehistoric dinosaur DNA deck attacking every opposing monster with Ultimate Tyranno and Super Conductor Tyranno.

name: Jim Crocodile Cook
title: Fossil Excavation Specialist
description: The Australian archaeologist duelist who travels with his crocodile Shirley. Jim excavates monster bones from both graveyards with Fossil Fusion.

decks.name: Prehistoric Fossil Fusion
decks.description: Jim Crocodile Cook's paleontologist deck banishing monsters from either player's graveyard to summon Fossil Dragon Skullgios.

name: Axel Brodie
title: Volcanic Mercenary
description: The stoic mercenary student from West Academy. Axel incinerates enemy boards with Blaze Cannon artillery, Volcanic Scattershot, and Volcanic Doomfire.

decks.name: Volcanic Blaze Accelerator
decks.description: Axel Brodie's tactical military burn deck launching Volcanic Shell and Scattershot through Blaze Accelerator to summon Volcanic Doomfire.

name: Adrian Gecko
title: Master of the Skies & Exodia
description: The calculating heir of the Gecko financial empire. Adrian uses battle-indestructible Cloudians with Fog Counters and summons Exodius the Ultimate Forbidden Lord.

decks.name: Cloudian Eye of the Typhoon
decks.description: Adrian Gecko's indestructible battle cloud deck accumulating Fog Counters to unleash the devastating storm of Eye of the Typhoon.

name: Sartorius Kumar
title: Leader of the Society of Light
tagline: Arcana Force Tarot of Destiny & Light Ruler
description: The enigmatic diviner and leader of the Society of Light. Sartorius spins the Wheel of Fate with Arcana Force monsters and summons the 4000 ATK Light Ruler.

decks.name: Arcana Force Tarot of Fate
decks.description: The Society of Light leader reading the tarot cards of destiny to freeze opponent turns with Arcana Force XXI - The World.

name: Yubel
title: The Eternal Dark Soul
description: The ancient Duel Spirit bonded to Jaden through eternity. Yubel cannot be destroyed in battle, turns all battle damage onto the attacker, and evolves through nightmares.

decks.name: Nightmare Reincarnation
decks.description: The ancient spirit of eternal love and torment evolving through Terror Incarnate into The Ultimate Nightmare to reflect all battle damage.

name: Nightshroud
title: Embodiment of Darkness
tagline: Darkness Field Spell & Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
description: The primordial void of Darkness. Commands the Darkness Field Spell (Zero and Infinity spell traps), Darkness Neosphere, and Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon.

decks.name: Darkness World & Neosphere
decks.description: The embodiment of universal nothingness commanding Darkness Neosphere, Darkness Destroyer, and Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon.

name: Yusuke Fujiwara
title: Wielder of Clear World
tagline: Clear World Attribute Void & Clear Vice Dragon
description: The mysterious student behind the Honest mystery. Fujiwara commands Clear World, punishing every attribute with severe handicaps while Clear Vice Dragon remains immune.

decks.name: Clear World Attribute Void
decks.description: Fujiwara's hollow attribute void deck penalizing every monster attribute with Clear World while attacking with the invincible Clear Vice Dragon.

name: Supreme King Jaden
title: Haou Judai - Ruler of Darkness
tagline: Evil HERO Malicious Bane & Dark Fusion
description: The merciless dark ruler of the alternate dimension. Supreme King Jaden commands corrupted Evil HEROs summoned via Dark Fusion and Super Polymerization.

decks.name: Evil HERO Dark Calling
decks.description: The cold and merciless Supreme King commanding corrupted Fiends through Dark Fusion and Dark Calling to summon Evil HERO Dark Gaia and Malicious Bane.

name: Yusei Fudo
title: Shooting Star Duelist
description: A brilliant and honorable Signer from Satellite who connects bonds with his monsters. Masters Junk, Synchron, and the legendary Stardust Dragon.

decks.name: Junk & Stardust Synchro
decks.description: Yusei Fudo's signature Synchro deck combining Junk Synchron, Doppelwarrior, and Quillbolt Hedgehog to summon Junk Warrior, Stardust Dragon, and Shooting Star Dragon.

decks.name: Majestic Star Acceleration
decks.description: Yusei's cosmic dragon deck channeling Majestic Dragon and Stardust Xiaolong to unleash the miraculous power of Majestic Star Dragon.

name: Jack Atlas
title: Master of Faster & The King
description: The proud, former King of Turbo Duels. Crushes all opposition with overwhelming ATK, Resonators, Double Tuning, and Red Dragon Archfiend.

decks.name: Red Dragon Resonator King
decks.description: The King's supreme power deck commanding Dark, Flare, and Creation Resonators alongside Vice Dragon to summon Red Dragon Archfiend and double-tune into Red Nova Dragon.

name: Crow Hogan
title: Blackwing Whirlwind
description: A fierce protector of orphans in the Satellite and a member of Team 5D's. Deploys rapid Blackwing swarms and deadly Icarus Attacks.

decks.name: Blackwing Whirlwind Assault
decks.description: Crow Hogan's lightning-fast Blackwing deck swarming the field with Bora, Shura, Gale, and Kalut under Black Whirlwind to summon Blackwing Armor Master.

decks.name: Blackwing Vayu Turbo & Black-Winged Dragon
decks.description: Crow's premier tournament-grade graveyard strategy banishing Vayu and high-level Blackwings from the GY to summon Silverwind and shielding with Black-Winged Dragon.

name: Akiza Izinski
title: Black Rose Witch
tagline: Black Rose Dragon & Botanical Thorn Thickets
description: A telekinetic Signer possessing the Mark of the Dragon. Clears battlefields with Black Rose Dragon and dominates with fertile Plant engines.

decks.name: Black Rose Botanical Destruction
decks.description: The Black Rose's fearsome botanical deck manipulating Rose Tokens with Black Garden and tuning Twilight Rose Knight to wipe the field with Black Rose Dragon.

name: Leo
title: Morphtronic Gadget Whiz
description: Luna's energetic twin brother whose passion burns bright. Equips Morphtronic appliances with powerful gear and unleashes Power Tool Dragon.

decks.name: Morphtronic Power Tool Assembly
decks.description: Leo's inventive household appliance deck morphing between attack and defense modes to search Equip Spells with Power Tool Dragon and evolve into Life Stream Dragon.

name: Luna
title: Voice of the Duel Spirits
description: A gentle Signer who can communicate directly with Duel Spirits. Protects her friends with Ancient Fairy Dragon, Kuribon, and enchanted forests.

decks.name: Ancient Fairy Forest Sanctuary
decks.description: Luna's gentle spirit deck protecting Life Points with Kuribon and Spirit Barrier while utilizing Ancient Forest to bring forth Ancient Fairy Dragon.

name: Kalin Kessler
title: Leader of the Enforcers
description: Former leader of the Enforcers and Dark Signer who embraces the void. When his hand is empty, his Infernity combo engine unleashes devastation.

decks.name: Infernity Handless Doom
decks.description: Kalin Kessler's devastating 'Handless Combo' deck activating unstoppable effects when holding zero cards in hand to loop Infernity Archfiend into Infernity Doom Dragon.

decks.name: Dark Signer Ccapac Apu & Hundred Eyes
decks.description: Kalin's terrifying Dark Signer deck unleashing Earthbound Immortal Ccapac Apu for 3000 direct damage and Hundred Eyes Dragon copying fallen Infernity effects.

name: Antinomy
title: Visor & Delta Accel Master
tagline: T.G. Tech Genus & Top Clear Mind
description: A warrior from the apocalyptic future who taught Yusei the secrets of Accel Synchro. Deploys high-tech Tech Genus cyborgs and Halberd Cannon.

decks.name: T.G. Accel Synchro Mechanics
decks.description: Antinomy's futuristic scientific deck replacing destroyed Tech Genus monsters to perform Top Clear Mind and Delta Accel Synchro Summon T.G. Halberd Cannon.

name: Sherry LeBlanc
title: Noble Knight of the Revolution
description: A fierce French noblewoman seeking vengeance and truth. Combines elegant floral Tuners, Chevalier de Fleur, and counter-traps like Liberty at Last!.

decks.name: Fleur Floral Chivalry
decks.description: Sherry LeBlanc's noble French cavalry deck synchronizing Fleur Synchron and Sorciere de Fleur into Chevalier de Fleur and Baronne de Fleur.

name: Zone
title: Architect of the Future
description: The final survivor of humanity's ruin who traveled back in time to alter history. Wields the invincible Timelords and the ultimate deity Sephylon.

decks.name: Timelord Celestial Judgment
decks.description: The leader of Yliaster's apocalyptic deck wielding the indestructible avatars Metaion and Sandaion to manifest the godlike power of Sephylon, the Ultimate Timelord.

name: Carly Carmine
title: Fortune Teller & Dark Signer Hummingbird
tagline: Fortune Lady Draw Power & Earthbound Immortal Aslla piscu
description: An enthusiastic reporter who fell to the dark side as a Dark Signer. Wields Level-scaling Fortune Ladies and Earthbound Immortal Aslla piscu.

decks.name: Fortune Lady Divination
decks.description: Carly Carmine's astrological deck whose Fortune Ladies grow stronger with every Standby Phase, drawing cards with Fortune Lady Water and banishing threats with Fortune's Future.

name: Rex Goodwin
title: Director of Sector Security & Condor Signer
tagline: Sun Dragon Inti, Moon Dragon Quilla & Wiraqocha Rasca
description: The former Director of Sector Security who bore both the Signer and Dark Signer marks. Wields the eternal cycle of Sun Dragon Inti and Moon Dragon Quilla.

decks.name: Inca Eclipse - Sun & Moon Dragons
decks.description: Rex Goodwin's high-priest deck orchestrating the endless cycle of day and night by synchronizing Sun Dragon Inti and Moon Dragon Quilla.

decks.name: Dark Signer Supreme God Wiraqocha Rasca
decks.description: Rex Goodwin unleashing the 100th Dark Signer God Earthbound Immortal Wiraqocha Rasca to discard the opponent's hand and drop their Life Points directly to 1.

name: Roman Goodwin
title: Leader of the Dark Signers & Spider Mark
description: The terrifying leader of the Dark Signers who sacrificed his humanity for the power of the Netherworld. Commands spider fiends and Earthbound Immortal Uru.

decks.name: Dark Spider Underground Web
decks.description: The leader of the Dark Signers' web of entrapment shifting opposing monsters into defense position to summon Underground Arachnid and Earthbound Immortal Uru.

name: Misty Tredwell
title: Top Model & Dark Signer Lizard
tagline: Reptilianne 0-ATK Gorgon Lock & Earthbound Immortal Ccarayhua
description: A famous supermodel who became a Dark Signer seeking vengeance. Wields petrifying Reptilianne monsters that reduce opponent ATK to 0 and Earthbound Immortal Ccarayhua.

decks.name: Reptilianne Gorgon's Gaze
